en: Sepia-toned photograph showing the interior of a traditional earthen house. Two veiled women sit on the floor or low cushions beside a round raised hearth or platform, with a metal coffee or tea pot placed on it. The roof is made of exposed wooden beams with reed or palm matting. The plastered walls feature small arched niches and a built-in arched alcove bed or bench; a shelf above holds several rounded objects, possibly pots or bread loaves. The overall feel is of an early‑20th‑century ethnographic scene in a Middle Eastern or North African rural dwelling.
